presentation.label: ADHD assessment
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us what makes you think you may have ADHD and how it is affecting you.

questions.question: How long have you felt this way?
Are your symptoms affecting your work, studies, daily routine or social interaction?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the symptoms are affecting the patient's work, studies or daily life?

questions.question: Have you previously suffered from any other mental health issues?
Has anyone in your family suffered from ADHD or any other mental health issues?
Are you hoping to trial ADHD medication?
